title: Upon Waking Up
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
translation: Sari tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne hamein maut (jaisi neend) ke baad zinda kiya, aur usi ki taraf lautna hai.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur

title: Before Sleeping
translation: Aey Allah! Tere naam se main marta hoon aur jeeta hoon.

title: Before Eating
note: If you forget to say it before starting, say "Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirih" (In the name of Allah, at its beginning and its end) as soon as you remember.

title: After Eating
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
translation: Sari tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne mujhe ye khilaya aur bina meri kisi taqat-o-qoowat ke mujhe ye rizq diya.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah

title: Entering the Home
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
translation: Allah ke naam se hum andar aaye, aur Allah ke naam se hum bahar jaate hain, aur apne Rab Allah hi par hamara bharosa hai.
transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Allahi Rabbina tawakkalna
note: Followed by greeting the household with Salam.

title: Leaving the Home
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
translation: Allah ke naam se, maine Allah par bharosa kiya, aur Allah ke siwa koi taqat aur qoowat nahi.
transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'ala Allahi wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

title: Entering the Masjid
translation: Aey Allah! Mere liye apni rahmat ke darwaze khol de.

title: Leaving the Masjid
translation: Aey Allah! Main tujh se tera fazl (fazl-o-karam) maangta hoon.

title: Entering the Bathroom
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
translation: Aey Allah! Main tere paas naapak jinnaat, mard aur aurat, dono se panah maangta hoon.
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba'ith

title: Leaving the Bathroom
reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 30; Sunan Ibn Majah 300

title: Wearing New Clothes
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
translation: Aey Allah! Sari tareef teri hai, tu ne hi mujhe ye pehnaya hai. Main is ki bhalai aur is ke maqsad ki bhalai maangta hoon, aur is ki buraai aur is ke maqsad ki buraai se panah maangta hoon.
transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanihi, as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah

title: On Sighting the New Moon
arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
translation: Allah sab se bada hai. Aey Allah! Is chaand ko hum par amn-o-iman, salamati aur Islam, aur un kaamon ki taufeeq ke saath tulu farma jinhein hamara Rab pasand aur pasand karta hai. Hamara aur tera Rab Allah hai.
transliteration: Allahu Akbar. Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-Islam, wat-tawfiqi lima tuhibbu Rabbana wa tarda. Rabbuna wa Rabbukal-lah

title: When Sneezing
translation: Sari tareef Allah ke liye hai.
note: Those who hear it should reply "Yarhamukallah" (Allah have mercy on you); the sneezer then replies "Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum" (May Allah guide you and set your affairs right).
